name: Design Quote
office_task: When a customer accepts their solar or heat-pump design and it is on the job, draft the job's quote lines from our own price book, or park it with a reason, and leave it for us to send.
systems_of_record: Xero (Items as the price book, Quotes)

emits.write: A draft quote on the job the accepted design is attached to, ex GST, carrying the design's id. One line per equipment or install item on the accepted design: the catalogue id from the business's own price book, the whole-number count from the design, and that item's sell-rate as read at draft time. The amount is count times rate and nothing else; the design tool's own prices are never used, and no STC or rebate deduction is applied. It is left in draft, editable, for the person who owns quotes; this node has no way to send it.
emits.readback: The quote is read back by the id the system returned (Simpro GET /api/v1.0/companies/{companyID}/quotes/{quoteID}, ServiceM8 GET /api_1.0/jobquote/{uuid}.json, Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Quotes/{QuoteID}) and must carry the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises quote.write_failed.

emits.write: A parked quote, or a job sent back for its design, as an exception on the job: the park reason from the standard's fixed list (or design_quantity_not_whole), the design id, the lines that did price with their catalogue ids, the items that did not, no total, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for quotes.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id; reading the job by its id shows the open exception with its exception_owner, and the next hop reads it there and stops.
